# opensearch_workspace (Resource)

Provides an OpenSearch workspace resource. Workspaces allow you to segregate your OpenSearch Dashboards into multiple tenants. This feature is available in OpenSearch 2.18 and later. Please refer to the [OpenSearch Dashboards workspace documentation](https://docs.opensearch.org/docs/latest/dashboards/workspace/workspace/) for details.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Create a workspace
resource "opensearch_workspace" "analytics" {
  name        = "analytics-workspace"
  description = "Workspace for analytics team"
  features    = ["discover", "visualize", "dashboard"]
}

# Create a workspace with minimal configuration
resource "opensearch_workspace" "simple" {
  name = "simple-workspace"
}

# Create a workspace with permissions
resource "opensearch_workspace" "secured" {
  name        = "secured-workspace"
  description = "Workspace with access controls"
  features    = ["discover", "visualize"]
  
  permissions {
    library_write {
      users  = ["admin_user", "power_user"]
      groups = ["admin_group"]
    }
    
    library_read {
      users  = ["readonly_user"]
      groups = ["readonly_group"]
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the workspace.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the workspace.
- `features` (Set of String) List of features enabled for this workspace.
- `permissions` (Block List, Max: 1) Permissions configuration for the workspace. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--permissions))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `workspace_id` (String) The ID of the workspace.

<a id="nestedblock--permissions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `permissions`

Optional:

- `library_read` (Block List, Max: 1) Users and groups with read permissions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--permissions--library_read))
- `library_write` (Block List, Max: 1) Users and groups with write permissions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--permissions--library_write))

<a id="nestedblock--permissions--library_read"></a>
### Nested Schema for `permissions.library_read`

Optional:

- `groups` (Set of String) List of groups with read permissions.
- `users` (Set of String) List of users with read permissions.


<a id="nestedblock--permissions--library_write"></a>
### Nested Schema for `permissions.library_write`

Optional:

- `groups` (Set of String) List of groups with write permissions.
- `users` (Set of String) List of users with write permissions.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import opensearch_workspace.analytics <workspace-id>
```
